readings.source_reading: ⟦d. 288(2)⟧ [long line, wavy over the gutter; between about x1330 and x1560 a doubled stroke, a straight dash with the wavy strike arching over it; a straight segment continues to about x2040] ⟦tr. into Marāthi⟧
readings.evidence: Native tile [0,3216] around y≈4095 shows two strokes, one above the other, over about x1330–1560. One may be a ditto dash overlaid by the strike. The other may only be a loop of the strike. The tile cannot settle this.

readings.source_reading: b018: '✓ ——— ext.: Kārtavīryārjunasahasranāmastotra.' (indented, directly below d. 948). b019: '✓ Uḍḍāmareśvara Tantra. (Treated as distinct by Aufrecht.)'. b020–b022: 'ext.: Kārtavīrya dīpa dāna kalpa' / 'Kārtavīryakavaca' / 'kārtavīryārjunakavaca', each with a faint tick to the right.
readings.evidence: The b018 dash sits below the d. 948 title column, which favours d. 948. The b020–b022 lines follow the Uḍḍāmareśvara heading without any dash. No connector is explicit in either case.
